record.original_question: Suppose f is a polynomial with zeros Z(f) in the complement of the open unit disk D, and let q_n be the n-th optimal polynomial approximant of 1/f in H^2_omega. For which weights {omega_k}_{k in N} is it true that 1 - q_n f converges to 0 uniformly on compact subsets of D \ Z(f)?

evidence.quote: Given a function f in H^2_omega not identically 0 and n in N, we define the n-th optimal polynomial approximant of 1/f in H^2_omega to be the polynomial q_n that minimizes ||pf - 1||_omega among all polynomials p of degree at most n.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\{\omega_k\}_{k\in\mathbb{N}_0}$ be a sequence of positive real weights, and let $H^2_\omega$ denote the Hilbert space of analytic functions $f(z)=\sum_{k=0}^\infty a_k z^k$ on the open unit disk $\mathbb{D}=\{z\in\mathbb{C}:|z|<1\}$ with finite norm
$$\|f\|_\omega^2 = \sum_{k=0}^\infty |a_k|^2 \omega_k < \infty.$$
For $f\in H^2_\omega$ not identically zero and $n\in\mathbb{N}_0$, the $n$-th optimal polynomial approximant of $1/f$ in $H^2_\omega$ is defined as the polynomial $q_n$ of degree at most $n$ that minimizes $\|pf-1\|_\omega$ among all polynomials $p$ of degree at most $n$.

Now suppose $f$ is a polynomial whose zero set $Z(f)$ lies entirely in $\mathbb{C}\setminus\mathbb{D}$ (i.e., all zeros have modulus $\ge 1$), and let $q_n$ be the $n$-th optimal polynomial approximant of $1/f$ in $H^2_\omega$.

Characterize the weight sequences $\{\omega_k\}_{k\in\mathbb{N}_0}$ for which $1-q_n f \to 0$ uniformly on compact subsets of $\mathbb{D}\setminus Z(f)$ as $n\to\infty$.
artifact.status_search_result: The question is posed as an open question in a survey on optimal polynomial approximants. Recent work (e.g., 2023–2025 papers on optimal polynomial approximants in H^p and via electrostatic/OPUC approaches) confirms uniform convergence on compact subsets of D\Z(f) in specific cases such as the Hardy space H^2 and the Bergman space A^2, but a full characterization for general weight sequences {ω_k} does not appear in the available literature.

status_evidence.title: Optimal polynomial approximants and orthogonal polynomials on the unit circle
status_evidence.snippet: Connection between cyclic functions and OPUC via optimal polynomial approximants; uniform convergence on compact subsets is a central theme.
status_evidence.claim: Recent work continues to investigate convergence properties of OPAs without giving a general weight characterization.

status_evidence.title: Optimal Polynomial Approximants in H^p
status_evidence.snippet: Studies OPAs in H^p spaces, extending classical H^2 results.
status_evidence.claim: Subsequent literature addresses related but distinct settings, suggesting the weighted-H^2 question remains open.
